sentences.text: Researchers investigated the role of the deubiquitinase STUB1 in postoperative cognitive dysfunction using a mouse model.
When STUB1 was removed specifically in microglia, the resulting cognitive deficits in these mice were reduced.
At the cellular level, STUB1 removes ubiquitin from NQO1 at the K61 site, triggering p62-mediated autophagic degradation that promotes ferroptosis.
Although STUB1 was not directly linked to standard markers like GPX4, it was associated with the non-canonical signal NQO1, whose levels correlated with cognitive impairment.
Experiments confirmed that this NQO1-dependent process drives microglial ferroptosis, suggesting the pathway could serve as a therapeutic target.
